![Engagement Ring vs. Wedding Ring | LaneWoods Jewelry](https://api.dataforseo.com/cdn/i/09290840-2330-0066-0000-284c20454952:4)
The main difference is that an [engagement ring](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/engagement-ring-vs-wedding-ring/) is given during a marriage proposal to symbolize the intent to marry, while a [wedding ring](https://www.austenblake.us/blog/wedding-ring-vs-engagement-ring) is exchanged during the wedding ceremony to seal the vows.[[1]](https://www.austenblake.us/blog/wedding-ring-vs-engagement-ring)

### Engagement Ring

- **When given:** During the marriage proposal.[[1]](https://www.austenblake.us/blog/wedding-ring-vs-engagement-ring)
- **Design:** Features a prominent center diamond or gemstone with a high profile.[[1]](https://www.brilliantearth.com/guides/engagement-ring-vs-wedding-ring/)
- **Cost:** Generally more expensive because of the large center stone.[[1]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/engagement-ring-vs-wedding-ring/)
- **How it is worn:** Placed on the left ring finger during the proposal and worn throughout the engagement.[[1]](https://www.alexisrussell.com/blogs/journal/engagement-ring-vs-wedding-ring-are-engagement-rings-and-wedding-rings-the-same)[[2]](https://www.austenblake.us/blog/wedding-ring-vs-engagement-ring)

### Wedding Ring (Wedding Band)

- **When given:** Exchanged during the wedding ceremony.[[1]](https://www.austenblake.us/blog/wedding-ring-vs-engagement-ring)
- **Design:** Usually a plain metal band or a simple band with small pavé or channel-set accent stones for everyday comfort.[[1]](https://fosterjewelry.com/blogs/articles/engagement-ring-vs-wedding-ring)[[2]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/engagement-ring-vs-wedding-ring/)
- **Cost:** Typically less expensive than an engagement ring.[[1]](https://www.gabrielny.com/blog/engagement-ring-vs-wedding-ring/)
- **How it is worn:** Placed on the left ring finger during the ceremony, often worn stacked below the engagement ring after marriage.[[1]](https://billigjewelers.com/blogs/wedding/engagement-ring-vs-wedding-ring-key-differences)[[2]](https://primestyle.com/blogs/diamond-ring/wedding-ring-vs-engagement-ring)
